user.title: Set up Roller Shutter Suite
user.description: Do you want to set up Roller Shutter Suite? The next pages ask for the values of the house. Groups and windows inherit them unless they set their own.

features.title: Features
features.description: Choose what is switched on. Only the features that are switched on get a page of their own.

data_description.schedule_enabled: Opens the shutters in the morning and closes them in the evening. While it is switched off, the daily routine moves nothing; protection keeps running.

feature_daily_routine_general.title: Daily routine
feature_daily_routine_general.description: How far the shutters open and close, how workdays, weekends and public holidays are told apart, and what else can begin the evening. The times follow on the next pages, one page per kind of day.

data_description.schedule_morning_position: Where the shutter goes in the morning. 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. The morning only raises: a shutter that is already higher stays where it is.
data_description.schedule_evening_position: Where the shutter goes in the evening. 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. The evening only lowers: a shutter that is already lower stays where it is.
data_description.schedule_workday_source_choice: An entity that is on on workdays, for example the workday sensor of Home Assistant. With "None", Monday to Friday are workdays.
data_description.schedule_holiday_source_choice: An entity that is on on public holidays; a calendar with an all-day event works too. With "None" there are no public holidays.
data_description.schedule_season_source_choice: An entity that is on while it is summer. While it has no value, its last known value counts.
data_description.schedule_summer_by_date: Without a summer entity, summer lasts from the first to the last day given below.
data_description.schedule_summer_first_day: Month and day with two digits each, for example 05-01 for 1 May.
data_description.schedule_summer_last_day: Month and day with two digits each, for example 09-30 for 30 September. The range may run across the turn of the year.
data_description.schedule_evening_position_summer: Replaces the evening position while it is summer, for example 30 % for privacy with some air. It counts only with a summer entity or with summer by date.
data_description.schedule_brightness_source_choice: An entity that reports the outdoor brightness in lux. When it has been darker than the threshold for the delay, the evening begins early, but never before "not before" of the evening. An entity without a value begins nothing and blocks nothing.
data_description.schedule_brightness_threshold_lux: Below this outdoor brightness, in lux, it counts as dark.

expert.name: Expert values
expert.description: Sensible defaults apply. Change them only if you know why.

data_description.schedule_brightness_delay: For how many minutes it has to be dark before the evening begins.
data_description.schedule_random_offset: Moves every trigger by up to this many minutes, earlier or later, differently for each window and day. 0 switches it off; 30 is the maximum.

feature_daily_routine_workday.title: Daily routine on workdays
feature_daily_routine_workday.description: When the morning and the evening begin on a workday.

data_description.schedule_workday_evening_kind: A fixed time; sunrise in the morning or sunset in the evening, with an offset; or the elevation of the sun. For the two that follow the sun, "not before" and "not after" under the expert values limit the time.

feature_movement_general.title: Movement
feature_movement_general.description: How the integration spares the motors: it leaves out movements that are not worth it, waits between two comfort movements, and does not start all motors of a collective movement at the same moment. Protection movements are never held back by the minimum change and the minimum interval, and a fire alarm is never held back by any of these settings.

data_description.motor_min_change: A comfort movement smaller than this is left out. 0 switches it off. A shutter is still driven fully open or fully closed, however small the rest is. It can only be judged for covers that report their position; a cover that reports none is always moved.
data_description.motor_min_interval: The shortest time between two comfort movements of the window, against flapping while shading follows the sun. 0 switches it off. Something new, such as the morning or the evening, sleep mode switched on, or the start of shading, moves at once all the same.
data_description.stagger_gap: When many shutters move together, their motors start one after the other. This gap, in seconds, is reserved after each motor of this window: the next motor, of this window or of another one, starts when it has passed. A value of 0 switches staggering off for this window; its covers start together when its turn comes. A fire alarm is never staggered. The gap between the covers of one window only matters for a window with several covers.

expert.name: Expert values
expert.description: Sensible defaults apply. Change them only if you know why.

data.reevaluate_after: Look again at the latest after

data_description.reevaluate_after: When a movement waits for something whose end nobody knows, for example for a cover to become available again, the window is looked at again after this time at the latest.

features.description: Choose what is decided here. "Inherit" follows the level above; the entry shows what that means at present. Only the features that are switched on get a page of their own.

data_description.schedule_enabled: Opens the shutters in the morning and closes them in the evening. While it is switched off, the daily routine moves nothing; protection keeps running. "Inherit" follows {schedule_enabled_source}.

feature_daily_routine_general.title: Daily routine
feature_daily_routine_general.description: How far the shutters open and close, how workdays, weekends and public holidays are told apart, and what else can begin the evening. The times follow on the next pages, one page per kind of day.

data_description.schedule_morning_position: Where the shutter goes in the morning. 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. The morning only raises: a shutter that is already higher stays where it is. Leave empty to inherit. Inherited at present: {schedule_morning_position_inherited} (from {schedule_morning_position_source}).
data_description.schedule_evening_position: Where the shutter goes in the evening. 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. The evening only lowers: a shutter that is already lower stays where it is. Leave empty to inherit. Inherited at present: {schedule_evening_position_inherited} (from {schedule_evening_position_source}).
data_description.schedule_workday_source_choice: An entity that is on on workdays, for example the workday sensor of Home Assistant. With "None", Monday to Friday are workdays. Inherited at present: {schedule_workday_source_inherited} (from {schedule_workday_source_source}).
data_description.schedule_holiday_source_choice: An entity that is on on public holidays; a calendar with an all-day event works too. With "None" there are no public holidays. Inherited at present: {schedule_holiday_source_inherited} (from {schedule_holiday_source_source}).

data_description.schedule_summer_by_date: Without a summer entity, summer lasts from the first to the last day given below. "Inherit" follows {schedule_summer_by_date_source}.

Inherited at present: {schedule_evening_position_summer_inherited} (from {schedule_evening_position_summer_source}).

feature_movement_general.title: Movement
feature_movement_general.description: How the integration spares the motors: it leaves out movements that are not worth it, waits between two comfort movements, and does not start all motors of a collective movement at the same moment. Protection movements are never held back by the minimum change and the minimum interval, and a fire alarm is never held back by any of these settings.

data_description.motor_min_change: A comfort movement smaller than this is left out. 0 switches it off. A shutter is still driven fully open or fully closed, however small the rest is. It can only be judged for covers that report their position; a cover that reports none is always moved. Leave empty to inherit. Inherited at present: {motor_min_change_inherited} (from {motor_min_change_source}).
data_description.motor_min_interval: The shortest time between two comfort movements of the window, against flapping while shading follows the sun. 0 switches it off. Something new, such as the morning or the evening, sleep mode switched on, or the start of shading, moves at once all the same. Leave empty to inherit. Inherited at present: {motor_min_interval_inherited} (from {motor_min_interval_source}).
data_description.stagger_gap: When many shutters move together, their motors start one after the other. This gap, in seconds, is reserved after each motor of this window: the next motor, of this window or of another one, starts when it has passed. A value of 0 switches staggering off for this window; its covers start together when its turn comes. A fire alarm is never staggered. The gap between the covers of one window only matters for a window with several covers. Leave empty to inherit. Inherited at present: {stagger_gap_inherited} (from {stagger_gap_source}).

window_covers_unreadable.title: Window "{window}" is not set up

Comfort functions that depend on a faulty value pause for the windows concerned, so that no shutter moves unexpectedly. setting_fault_group_level_unreadable.title: A stored setting cannot be used: group "{name}"
setting_fault_group_level_unreadable.description: The stored settings cannot be read as a whole. Functions that protect people or hardware or that restrict movement keep running. They use the value of the next level; where no level sets one, they use a cautious value, which may restrict movements more than usual until the setting is repaired. Comfort functions that depend on a faulty value pause for the windows concerned, so that no shutter moves unexpectedly. To repair this, open the group, check its values and save it, or remove the group.

setting_fault_group_other.title: A stored setting cannot be used: group "{name}"
setting_fault_group_other.description: Something is wrong with the stored setting "{key}" that this version of the integration cannot describe more precisely. Comfort functions that depend on a faulty value pause for the windows concerned, so that no shutter moves unexpectedly. To repair this, open the group, check its values and save it, or remove the group.
